facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no exchange controls since the dollar floated in 1983.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, but bank foreign-currency accounts can need AUD 50,000 to open.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Get a free ABN as a sole trader; register a business name only if needed.
facts.L2_tax_id: Tax File Number (TFN); your business uses an ABN.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed: nil to AUD 18,200, up to 45%, plus 2% Medicare levy.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 10% GST; register once turnover reaches AUD 75,000; exports are GST-free.
facts.L5_data_protection: Privacy Act 1988 covers larger businesses and some smaller ones.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Consumer guarantees apply online; change-of-mind refunds are up to you.
facts.L7_incentives: Up to AUD 1,000 small business tax offset; personal services income usually excluded.

watch_out.text: Register for GST within 21 days of knowing you'll pass AUD 75,000.
Solo contractors' personal services income often doesn't qualify for the tax offset.
